pages.title: Sintering Press
pages.text: Powder pressed and fired just below melting, until its grains grow together into one dense solid.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
Set the pressure and the temperature. Hotter and harder packs it denser, but hotter also grows the grains: density 97% or more with grains under 5 µm.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 1 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Alumina Ceramic Plate, Neodymium Alloy Blank.
